## IPinotQueryOptions.skipUpsertDelete property

For upsert-enabled tables, include rows deleted via `deleteRecordColumn` (tombstones), which queries exclude by default.

**Signature:**

```typescript
skipUpsertDelete?: boolean;
```

## Default Value

`false`
